name: pickup_resolve_owner_from_bvol_hit
description: Pickup::ResolveOwnerFromBvolHit replaces a pickup bounding-volume hit node with its owner pickup node and reports whether the replacement happened.
known_limits: The smoke covers bvol owner replacement plus null and non-bvol no-op returns. tier S verification is deferred to a pickup/contact source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x41cf30 validates the null check, node flag 0x40000 gate, owner node at callback-context offset 0x24, nodeInOut replacement, and EAX 0/1 return contract.
The native smoke verifies replacement and no-op cases.
